name: task-board
description: Multi-session progress band: one bar per session with status, task progress, token use and a prompt-cache countdown; optional next-step suggestions above the prompt (one global on/off switch on the board).

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 60 on a subscription; usually 5 on pay-as-you-go API. The countdown uses this.

cacheWarnMinutes.title: Warn before cache expires (minutes)
cacheWarnMinutes.description: Show one toast when this session has this many minutes of cache left; 0 = never.

nextStepsMinChars.title: Skip suggestions after short answers
nextStepsMinChars.description: No suggestion (and no extra request) after answers shorter than this many characters.

nextStepsSkills.title: Let suggestions use skills and slash commands
nextStepsSkills.description: Give the suggester this session's skills and slash commands so a suggestion can be /skill-name.

sharedDir.title: Shared folder for other computers
sharedDir.description: A folder in a synced drive (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Syncthing). Each computer writes its sessions there and the board shows everyone's. Empty = this computer only. ~ = your home folder.

deviceName.title: This computer's label
deviceName.description: Short name shown as a grey tag on this computer's cards on the other computers, and used as its file name in the shared folder. Give every computer a different one.
